title: No Check, Still Fatal
setup: Your rook on d1 is lined up on the black queen, with only your own bishop on d3 standing in between.
hint: The rook on b5 is guarded by a pawn. Ask what the d-file will look like once your bishop has left it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxb5}} wins a rook because the recapture costs more: after axb5 the d-file is open and Rxd8 takes the queen. Black has to leave the bishop where it is, and White keeps the rook it won. A discovery does not need a check to decide a game.
